name: Acid glob icon
description: UI slot icon for the spitter. The glyph is not a second drawing of the weapon — it composes `ss.proj.bolt` itself via `use`, so the icon can never drift from the projectile the way the original i_wand and p_bolt did; when that document stopped being a knapped shell dart and became a drop of acid, this followed with no edit here. Evolved is a rim swap, not a redraw.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_wand_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
